dogecoin.text:
They came up with the next dumb narrative to pump $doge even faster than I expected. Elon probably realized this am that he fucked up last night.

idk who needs to hear this, but he doesn't care about you.  Elon is only in it for the power trip. That was so clear during SNL.

I’m happy for those who made money and had fun, but this is why $doge mania is bad.

Doge was gateway to crypto for huge #s of new people, but it was always a meme pump and (eventual) dump. Lots of negative individual experience (and press) will now be associated w/ *real* crypto https://t.co/QJGeOcz6Yl

I should buy some $doge here at 55 cents.  These people are irrational psychos, and there will be the next new made-up narrative for why it's going to $1 within a few days.  And then it probably will.

some $doge bagholders on robinhood were apparently educated tonight about what happens when you do a Market Sell when everyone else is also trying to hit the exit at the same time.

It's hard for me to not find this funny. https://t.co/16oYeB9PtH

A question that $doge bag holders have hopefully at least thought about: who exactly will be buying it tonight to push up prices? Who is left to buy the meme who hasn’t bought it already? https://t.co/fu1ZCILvO5
$DOGE is down to 21 cents.  Only another 20 cents left to fall before it reaches fair value and the crypto bull market can resume. https://t.co/6nX6bVYqYX

@StealthQE4 I like to poke $doge twitter every so often because that crowd seems to particularly enjoy searching out doge-related tweets and then telling the strangers who wrote them why they are wrong and how it’s actually going to $100.

$doge is almost there… just need another 50% haircut.  

Remember a few months ago when @SNICKERS was celebrating this garbage? smh https://t.co/9PfB73LvDc

The $DOGE / $BTC chart is strange and mostly useless.

My assumption is that it’s because one is measured in pennies and the other in tens of thousands, and so the result is a number so small that chart software just rounds off the actually significant and useful decimals. https://t.co/ML7vksiSQ5
$matic is the new $doge / $shib, except it's actually real. #polygon

Muh trading bags heading into the year end. $dot $doge $matic $atom

Annoyedly also waiting on $ada and $sushi to flex above their current ceilings. https://t.co/8LhH99iaRp

or, maybe it's that we all have the same incredibly low opinion of Elon's brain-dead desciples that we all *think* that those morons are going to buy $doge because of the Twitter news, and so *we* buy doge and ram up the price on ourselves... 🤔

some of your brains make the strangest connections.
"Elon is buying Twitter? That must be good for $doge !!" https://t.co/X6GodFKdU7

@skannamalai i would def agree with you with respect to memes like dogecoin et al, but bitcoin and ethereum specifically have always had a strong “this is the future and the future is now” culture, even as prices have whipped around
